articles.title_orig: ‘Reacher’ Gets Early Season 6 Renewal Shortly After Season 4 Wraps With 66M Viewers In 28 Days
articles.title_zh: ‘Reacher’ Gets Early Season 6 Renewal Shortly After Season 4 Wraps With 66M Viewers In 28 Days
articles.content_orig:
Prime Video is picking up the pace on its Reacher renewals, handing its flagship drama starring Alan Ritchson a Season 6 pickup just 12 days after the Season 4 finale and four months after the early Season 5 order — the first time the show has received two renewals in the same year.
The expediency helps the series, developed by Nick Santora based on Lee Child’s books, to stay on a yearly cadence. Season 5, which already had been largely written at the time of the May greenlight, started production in late July in Toronto, ahead of Season 4’s August 12 premiere. It is based on Make Me , the 20th book in Child’s series. It has not been determined yet which novel will serve as source material for Season 6. (Ritchson, who also is an executive producer on Reacher, recently revealed on social media that Die Trying is his favorite book in the franchise, and that “I had it approved until someone got re-elected.”)
The renewal comes as Season 4 of Reacher has amassed 66 million viewers globally in its first 28 days on Prime Video, per Amazon, defying the recent downward streaming viewership trend by surpassing the Season 3 performance.
RELATED: ‘Reacher’s Kathleen Robertson Says Role Is “Certainly Set Up” To Become Powerful Ally In Season 5; Talks Moving ‘Tracker’ To L.A.
Seasons 2, 4 and 3 of Reacher (in that order) rank as the most-viewed returning seasons of all time on Prime Video, with Seasons 2 and 4 among the five most-viewed seasons of any original series in the platform’s history alongside the first seasons of The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power and Fallout.
Per Amazon, more than half (58%) of Reacher ’s Season 4 audience is based internationally, with outsized performance in the UK, Germany and Brazil.
The season has been big in the U.S. too; it just logged its fifth consecutive billion-minute weekly viewership tally on Nielsen’s weekly streaming rankings with 1.18 billion minutes, finishing No. 1 in four of the five weeks.
Additionally, Reacher has spawned a franchise with spinoff Neagley , starring Maria Sten, which is looking good for a Season 2 renewal.
RELATED: ‘Reacher’ Spinoff ‘Neagley’ Trailer: Maria Sten Is Out To Snare A Killer
“ Reacher hits hard,” said Peter Friedlander, Head of Global Television, Amazon MGM Studios. “What Lee Child has built and Nick Santora and his creative teams have brought to life is, simply, incredible. Alan Ritchson is Jack Reacher — he’s delivered a performance that has captivated audiences around the world. Together with our partners at Paramount Television Studios, we couldn’t be more excited to continue this journey. Reacher is a truly iconic series, and we’re thrilled to be on the ride with this extraordinary cast and crew for Season Six.”
Produced by Paramount Television Studios and Amazon MGM Studios, Reache r is written by Santora, who executive produces and serves as showrunner. In addition to Santora, Child and Ritchson, the list of executive producers include Don Granger, Scott Sullivan, Mick Betancourt, Lisa Kussner, Sam Hill, Amy Pocha & Seth Cohen.
In Season 4, based on Lee Child’s Gone Tomorrow , a chance encounter with a distraught stranger on a subway goes horribly wrong, drawing Jack Reacher (Ritchson) into a complex and deadly game that pits him against ruthless foes from the highest echelons of power. The season’s cast includes Chris Marquette, Sydelle Noel, Agnez Mo, Anggun, Kevin Weisman, Marc Blucas, Kevin Corrigan and Kathleen Robertson.

articles.title_zh: Raoni Barcelos breaks silence for first time after frightening Raul Rosas Jr KO left him in hospital
articles.content_orig:
Raoni Barcelos has spoken out for the first time since his worrying knockout defeat in Las Vegas on Saturday night.
Top ten bantamweight contender Barcelos was on course to land a decision win over Raul Rosas Jr in the main event of UFC Vegas 121 over the weekend. He was up by two rounds heading into the fifth, before seemingly being knocked out by a takedown .
Raoni Barcelos went out cold without taking a punch in the fifth round of his fight with Raul Rosas Jr.
Barcelos was since brought to hospital, where he underwent scans and spent days recovering. Fortunately, it was reported that he was communicative after the fact and he has now spoken via the comments section on a post on the UFC Brasil Instagram.
Raoni Barcelos has yet to post anything official to his Instagram page, but he did show up in the comments section of a UFC Brasil statement regarding his health.
“Hey everyone, I just want to let you all know that I’m doing great, and as soon as I can, I’ll send a video to all of you,” Barcelos said in a written comment that was translated by Instagram. “Thank you so much for everyone’s love, support, and prayers!
“I promised a great fight, and I delivered on that promise. Thank god, and thank you to everyone who fought alongside me, both inside and outside that cage.”

articles.content_orig:
Apple today released iOS 27.0.1, the first update for the iOS 27 update that came out two weeks ago .
iOS 27.0.1 can be downloaded over the air by going to Settings > General > Software Update. Apple has also released iPadOS 27.0.1 and visionOS 27.0.1 updates, as well as iOS and iPadOS 26.7.1 updates for devices not updated to iOS and iPadOS 27 .
According to Apple's release notes, iOS 27.0.1 addresses an issue that could cause Face ID not to work properly on the iPhone 18 Pro .
Some iPhone 18 Pro users have complained that authentication can fail to work for things like unlocking a locked app. In some cases, the device freezes up and then reboots. Other users have seen a "‌Face ID‌ is Not Available" message when attempting ‌Face ID‌ setup, and others have experienced issues with the Require Attention for ‌Face ID‌ setting. Apple's release notes for the update are below.
This update provides bug fixes for your iPhone, including fixes for the following issues:
- iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max may unexpectedly restart when Face ID fails to authenticate - A color artifact may appear on photos captured at 2x under certain lighting conditions at f/1.48 on a small number of iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max devices - Opening Notification Center and Control Center simultaneously may cause the touchscreen to become unresponsive
The ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ models have an infrared camera that's under the display for the first time, but it's unclear if the hardware has been causing a problem. Apple said last week that it would be able to address the ‌Face ID‌ bugs with a software update.
While the iOS 27.0.1 update has multiple ‌iPhone 18 Pro‌ bug fixes, it is available for all iPhones able to run ‌iOS 27‌.

articles.title_orig: Pope urges Europe to defend multilateralism as global order crumbles
articles.title_zh: Pope urges Europe to defend multilateralism as global order crumbles
articles.content_orig:
Pope Leo XIV has praised multilateralism as “the best defence against the desire for dominance” in a speech in the French city of Metz.
The pontiff lamented a world marked by conflict, from war and hunger to deteriorating personal relations, describing an “increasingly uncivilised” climate. He also criticised the “lies and deception” he said were fuelling growing distrust between citizens and governments.
Speaking in Schuman’s hometown, a city closely associated with European reconciliation, Leo said Europe could break this vicious cycle by reaffirming its commitment to the rule of law and dialogue.
"Europe can break this cycle by upholding the principle of respect for others, which it has successfully cultivated and maintained, having demonstrably shown over the past eighty years that it is possible to express divergent opinions, demands, and interests through dialogue rather than confrontation," he said.
The Pope delivered his address in French in the presence of French President Emmanuel Macron, who is due to attend a Mass with Leo later on Tuesday.
Although the Pope did not explicitly mention Russia's war against Ukraine, he condemned what he qualified as a new “pointless massacre" on European soil.
"It is necessary to engage in patient dialogue, to show courage in negotiations, and to be willing to compromise on certain positions for the greater good of peace."
Leo XIV also urged Europeans to remember the continent’s Christian roots, describing Europe as more than a geographical entity and instead a “cultural and historical reality”.
“We cannot speak of Europe, then, without mentioning Christianity,” he said, arguing that its traditions could coexist with efforts to shape the continent’s future.
Europe, he added, “has flourished and progressed when it was able to draw on the best aspects of its past and reinvent them in new and creative ways through encounter with others.”
The choice of Metz as the venue for the Pope’s address was rich in European symbolism.
Located in France’s northeastern Lorraine region, close to the German border, the city is closely associated with one of the founding figures of European integration, Robert Schuman. He opened his law practice there in 1912, and launched his political career in the city.
But Metz’s history also reflects the conflicts that shaped modern Europe. The city changed hands several times between France and Germany and was annexed by Nazi Germany in 1940, following France’s defeat and occupation.
The Élysée Palace said Monday’s programme was designed to highlight the “European and cross-border dimension” of Lorraine, a region at the crossroads of several countries with a shared and often painful history of war.
EU leaders and the heads of European institutions were invited to attend the event, although only a handful joined French President Emmanuel Macron, including representatives from Monaco, Andorra and Luxembourg.
The gathering also brought together representatives of different faiths, including France’s chief rabbi, Haïm Korsia, and Chems-Eddine Hafiz, rector of the Grand Mosque of Paris.
